request.style: English, driving rock, gritty powerful male vocal, distorted electric guitars, bass, pounding drums, organ swells in the bridge, urgent and dramatic, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Breathing threats and murder with the letters in his hand
Saul is riding to Damascus with a warrant and a plan
Every man and every woman who belongs to the Way
He will drag them back in chains to Jerusalem that day

[Pre-Chorus]
Suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him
He fell to the ground

[Chorus]
Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me
Who are you, Lord
I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting
Get up and go into the city
Light on the Damascus road

[Verse]
Three days in the darkness, and he would not eat or drink
Eyes wide open seeing nothing, nothing left to do but think
In a house on Straight Street there the blinded man would pray
While the Lord called Ananias and sent him on his way

[Pre-Chorus]
Suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him
He fell to the ground

[Chorus]
Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me
Who are you, Lord
I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting
Get up and go into the city
Light on the Damascus road

[Bridge]
Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus
Has sent me so that you may see again
Something like scales fell from his eyes
He got up and was baptized
The hunter of the church became the Lord's chosen instrument

[Outro]
Light on the Damascus road
Scales fall down and he can see
